thesis: A completed 15-minute selloff that is simultaneously RSI-oversold and materially below session VWAP can earn a long-only mean-reversion rebound after conservative costs.
rationale: A causal coarse screen of fixed holding returns found the RSI below 35, VWAP distance below minus 10 basis points, and one-bar return below minus 10 basis points family positive after six basis points of round-trip cost in every chronological segment. The event engine now evaluates a bounded neighborhood with official fills, risk exits, capacity controls, null tests, and immutable gates.
